sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Safiullah
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.7301 of 2022 at Police Station-Seorahi, District-Kushi Nagar under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 01.11.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 10.02.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Safiullah, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record,
entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. The delay in lodgment of the F.I.R. in the facts of the case is fatal to the prosecution case.
2. The applicant and the victim were intimate.

sentences.text: 3. The relationship subsequently went awry as the first informant had several love interests.
4. The victim became pregnant after a tryst with one of her love interests.
5. The F.I.R. was lodged to deflect attention from her conduct and to force the applicant to marry her.
6. No allegation of commission of rape has been made by the prosecution.
7. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
8. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Amit Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
Order Date :- 21.7.2023
